verdict.rationale: Base44 provides an official SDK with documented entities/CRUD methods, a CLI for creating/managing projects, and code examples for building against the backend, showing genuine SDK support (base44-docs-4, -17, -23, -28, -24). However, there's no OpenAPI spec (base44-probe-2 shows 404s), and community commentary frames Base44 primarily as an AI-driven no-code/low-code builder rather than a mature developer SDK ecosystem, suggesting the SDK is functional but secondary to the AI-first workflow.
